title: Same-timestamp collision silently drops lifecycle/terminal events from the rendered timeline and the evidence export
detail: collapse_same_at_sends drops ANY line whose `at` equals the previous line's — including form_opened/corrected/taken_over/substituted/terminal events — and send_line folds same-`at` lifecycle entries into send batches (empty channel/outcome mislabel them). The exported evidence record loses events silently.
recommended_fix: In collapse_same_at_sends, only drop a line when both kind and at match the previous send line; in send_line, filter the batch on send kinds (invitation_sent/co_nudge/reminder_sent), not at alone.
